name: Delicious Mors
desc: A fruit beverage in a deep red color. The sweet aroma of berry greets you before the glass ever reaches your lips. This perfectly balanced drink is bright and refreshing without ever feeling thin, with just enough honey to round out the berries' gentle tartness. One sip of this is all it takes to win over even the most discerning palate.

value.text: Restores 30% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 790 HP every 5s for 30s.
